title: Sprig
description: Sprig is a vanilla Fabric modpack built with care by the team behind Sapling.gg. Work perfectly on Sapling, experience smoother, cozier, and more immersive.
body:
![sprig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/186fbe56213333ac7fc512cc873e939a45365c8f_0.webp)

💻 **Latest Minecraft** - Sprig supports the Copper Age (1.21.10)!

🖼️ **Enchanced Visuals** – Shaders built to focus on quality and performance (Photon).

💡 **Optimized** – Smooth performance tweaks.

📃 **Minimal Setup** – Smooth performance and stunning visuals in under 50 mods.

🎮 **Better Together** - Sprig includes Essential mod to make it easy to play with friends, see who's online and hop into sessions together with minimal setup.

## Built for Sapling.gg
The pack is built by the team behind Xiled Sapling, matching it's focus on a friendly, community-driven server. Sprig ensures that everything feels stable and immersive whether you are joining a community project or just doing the every day Minecraft fun.

## Performance and Feel
Sprig includes lightweight fabric optimizations that have been carefully selected by our team and community. These selections help enchance FPS and responsiveness. 

## Socialising with Sprig
Sprig also makes it easy to play with your friends, We've added the Essential mod. Minecraft is better together! 

We are not associated with Essential Mod. For more information regarding this mod please see the official website: https://essential.gg/
